forms.name: Notice of Proposed Construction or Alteration

explanations.trigger_explanation: Tall structures and some shorter structures near airports or heliports commonly require advance notice to the Federal Aviation Administration through Form 7460-1.

known_unknowns: Notice can be required below 200 feet depending on airport proximity and obstruction surfaces.
advisories: Additional review recommended for poles, towers, transmission structures, and substation equipment with notable height near airports or heliports.
notes: Confidence tier 1 because the notice pathways and active form are directly supported by current Federal Aviation Administration materials.
